Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.calculator

Class CalculatorEngine

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.calculator.CalculatorEngine
public final class CalculatorEngine extends Object
Headless math engine behind CalculatorPanel: a recursive-descent evaluator over a small expression language plus the state a scientific calculator needs (angle mode, memory register, last answer).

Grammar, loosest binding first:

   expression := term { ('+' | '-') term }
   term       := factor { ('*' | '/' | 'mod') factor }
   factor     := ('-' | '+') factor | power
   power      := postfix [ '^' factor ]          (right associative)
   postfix    := primary { '!' | '%' }
   primary    := number | '(' expression ')' | constant
               | function '(' expression ')'

Functions: sin cos tan asin acos atan (angle-mode aware), ln log sqrt abs. Constants: pi, e, Ans (the last evaluated result). Postfix ! is the factorial and % divides by 100.

Deliberately free of Swing/AWT imports so it can be exercised headless.
